text:
maya.eng: starting a coordinated publish for py/ts SDK to push 1.5.0-rc1 with the new backoff logic. quiet window 23:30-00:30 UTC. will push staged artifacts then promote if no regressions. :rocket:

tom.platform: please create a `canary` dist-tag and a `rollback` tag before promotion. automated flipper will respect `rollback` if we hit error budgets.

jen.releases: noted. small canary note: yesterday we saw increased 429s on emb endpoint when batch size hit 64. adding a smoke that runs small batch + auth refresh.

deploy-bot: Publish triggered by maya.eng at 1759999050
deploy-bot: npm publish -> success
deploy-bot: pypi upload -> success
deploy-bot: Canary traffic -> 10% -> monitoring

maya.eng: quick smoke script i'm running: `for i in 1..10; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d "{\"inputs\":[1,2,3]}" https://api.redwood.example/v1/emb | jq -r '.status'; done`

jen.releases: seeing a 429 on the 3rd iteration. stack excerpt: `rate_limit: exceeded at worker-07 batch=64`. hold promo and roll back npm dist-tag to previous stable.

tom.platform: doing dist-tag ops now: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.8 latest` and `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.8 rollback` as fallback.

deploy-bot: Dist-tag updated -> latest now points to 1.4.8 at 1759999380

maya.eng: ok pausing. we'll patch batching logic and re-run RC. action items: add canary batch-size smoke to CI, add telemetry alert for 429 spike during release, and ensure `rollback` tag creation is in the release script. assigning tom.platform (dist-tag automation) and jen.releases (CI smoke).

doc-bot: automated PR created for release notes: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/501. includes deprecation note for legacy sync-client and migration link to `docs/migration/sync-client.md`.

jen.releases: small note for rollback playbook: include commands to verify dist-tag and to republish with `npm publish --tag rollback` in case we need a hotfix, and `twine upload --repository pypi dist/*` for python. adding to the release checklist.

maya.eng: thanks all. will reopen after we have the batching fix in canary and a green CI smoke. planning follow-up thread for the reattempt. :thumbsup:
